title: Northern Songs sues Maclen Music, Inc | 1971
content:
A lawsuit was filed by Northern Songs, Ltd in the New York Supreme Court on 22 July 1971 against Malen Music, Inc.

The lawsuit alleged that Paul and Linda McCartney had violated a prior agreement when collaborating on the song ‘Another Day’.

Northern Songs claimed actual damages of $50,000, and requested a further $1 million in punitive damages.
